title: Three Jews came into the room and started to
subtitle: 3 operations from 2 reading(s), pooled. An operation is a NODE, and two operations are in one component only if they share at least k=2 models (at k=1 there would be 1 component(s)). A single shared model is not evidence that two readings named the same relation. Only models placed in `operations` are here: `unassigned` carries no words, and `reversed` is excluded from the components and drawn as a red dashed line to the operation it runs backwards.

nodes.label: Coercion softens to speech
nodes.statement: An act of physical force, forcible restraint, coercive interrogation, or aggressive shouting directed at another party under condition A is replaced, in the same slot under condition B, by an act of calm verbal or ritual exchange among the parties (talking, arguing, praying, singing, chanting) that involves no force and no raised voice.

nodes.label: Interrogation redirects to exposure
nodes.statement: An act of official coercive force -- interrogation, torture, or lethal violence -- directed at a party under condition A is replaced, in the same slot under condition B, not by any calm or safe act but by an act of forcibly stripping or exposing that party's body.

nodes.label: violence-sociability trade
nodes.statement: Words naming physical or verbal harm done to a person rise toward the top of a sentence's likely completions under one condition, while words naming shared talk, ritual, or company rise under the other; which condition carries which set is not fixed and can run either way from one instance to the next.
